## 891b61bb5d4d

**Reproduced defect: advertised size and helpful-texture controls are accepted but ignored.**

Audited generator SHA-256:
`3bbd358d00a9648d8bdc829c944b0a2c317d8f5aef0d5b36d4f0557f6e886268`.
Across seeds 0–19 at medium difficulty, `grid_h=8` and `grid_h=16`
produced byte-identical grids in 20/20 comparisons; neither request produced the
requested height in any case. `grid_w=9` and `grid_w=16` were likewise
byte-identical in 20/20 comparisons and missed both requested widths in every
case. The advertised helpful textures `small_overlap` and `large_overlap` also
produced byte-identical grids in 20/20 comparisons. All probed outputs passed
`self_check`.

The source-level cause is concrete: dimensions are selected with raw
`rng.randint` rather than the declared context axes, and `texture` is inspected
only for the three degenerate values. The minimal source-bound reproducer and
all 20 rows are retained in
`checks/audit/891b61bb5d4d/probe_declared_axes.py` and
`checks/audit/891b61bb5d4d/declared-axis-probe.json`. This is an audit finding
only; no file under `generators/891b61bb5d4d/` was modified.

The optional combined audit preset completed but did not pass. Its task-test stage
reported `no_tests` (exit 5), and its strict semantic stage reported no declared
semantic contract (exit 2); see
`checks/audit/891b61bb5d4d/combined/checks/891b61bb5d4d_audit_summary.json`.
These scope failures neither approve nor invalidate the concrete axis reproducer.
